test_suite: GNU Health HMIS Live Browser End-to-End Transaction Verification

environment.application: GNU Health HMIS 4.4 / Tryton SAO 7.0.58 Web Client
environment.execution_mode: Native Headless Chrome Browser Automation (Zero Synthetic Mocks, Zero Direct SQL, 100% Native SAO UI User Actions)

phases.title: Front Desk User Authentication
phases.action: Open browser at http://34.7.237.8/, fill username, submit password via native dialog

phases.title: HMIS Main Dashboard Navigation
phases.action: Access Tryton SAO main dashboard with operational healthcare menus and global search bar

phases.title: Patient Demographics Registration
phases.action: Navigate to Health / Patients, click New (+), register LIVE E2E TEST PATIENT, gender Male, DOB 1990-01-01, auto-generate PUID KQI816APL, save record

phases.title: Outpatient Appointment Scheduling
phases.action: Navigate to Health / Appointments, click New (+), select patient LIVE E2E TEST PATIENT, select Dr. DEMO Physician 01, specialty Family Medicine, save appointment

phases.title: Patient Check-In Action Transition
phases.action: Open appointment, click action button CHECK IN, verify status transition to Checked in in form and list views

phases.title: Nursing Triage & Vital Signs Capture
phases.action: Navigate to Health / Patient Evaluations, create evaluation EVAL 2026/000050, record BP 120/80, HR 72, Temp 37.0C, Weight 70kg, Height 175cm, auto-compute BMI 22.9 kg/m2, save evaluation

phases.title: Physician Clinical Consultation & ICD-10 Coding
phases.action: Open evaluation, record clinical assessment, assign ICD-10 diagnosis J06.9 (Acute upper respiratory infection, unspecified), set discharge reason to Home / Selfcare, click DONE button to finalize

phases.title: E-Prescription & Safety Verification
phases.action: Navigate to Health / Prescriptions, create prescription PRES 2026/000044, add Amoxicillin 500mg, check Patient Safety Verified checkbox, save and click CREATE to issue

phases.title: Laboratory Criteria Loading & CBC Analyte Result Entry
phases.action: Navigate to Health / Laboratory / Tests, create lab test TEST037 for Complete Blood Count, click LOAD ANALYTES CRITERIA (20 items loaded), enter Hemoglobin 14.1 g/dL, save and transition to Done

phases.title: Radiology Imaging Request & Result Generation
phases.action: Navigate to Health / Medical Imaging / Medical Imaging Requests, request Chest X-Ray (Order 032), click GENERATE RESULTS to produce finalized Medical Imaging Results TEST030

phases.title: Billing Customer Invoice Creation & Posting
phases.action: Navigate to Financial / Invoices / Customer Invoices, create invoice INV-2026/00014 for LIVE E2E TEST PATIENT, add OPD-EVAL service (150.00 QAR, 401000 Main Revenue), click POST to commit to General Ledger

phases.title: Point-of-Sale Cash Payment Processing
phases.action: Click PAY on posted invoice, select Cash Payment (QAR) in SAO modal, click OK to register 150.00 QAR payment, verify invoice state transitions to Paid

phases.title: General Ledger & Double-Entry Move Verification
phases.action: Navigate to Financial / Entries / Account Moves, open Move 47 (MV-2026/00037), inspect balanced Debit (110000 Main Receivable: 150.00 QAR) and Credit (401000 Main Revenue: 150.00 QAR) entries

phases.title: End-to-End Full Chain Traceability Reopen
phases.action: Open LIVE E2E TEST PATIENT in SAO, open Relate Menu and open connected tabs for Appointments, Evaluations, Prescriptions, Lab Results, and Medical Imaging, verifying 100% interconnected data integrity
